name: Change a vehicle wheel safely
short_description: Secure a stationary vehicle and replace one wheel using its designated lifting and fastening points.
self_assessment: I can change one vehicle wheel without help on firm level ground and verify every fastener.
description: Secure a stationary vehicle and replace one wheel using its designated lifting and fastening points. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Replace a wheel during a stationary practice session

builds_on.note: Assembly practice supports systematic fastener checks.

safety_note: A falling or moving vehicle can kill; use firm level ground, secure against movement, use designated lifting points, and never work beneath it.
